nis_flu.name: National Immunization Survey-Flu (NIS-Flu)
nis_flu.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nis_flu.location: Weekly Influenza Vaccination Status and Intent for Vaccination, Children 6 Months-17 Years (FluVaxView dashboard)
nis_flu.description: The National Immunization Survey-Flu (NIS-Flu) is a national random-digit-dialed cellular telephone survey of households with children ages 6 months-17 years, conducted by CDC's National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases from October through June each flu season. A parent or guardian who knows the child's vaccination history reports whether and when the child received a flu vaccine; estimates are weighted to the population of each state and the nation. CDC publishes weekly cumulative coverage and, since the 2023-24 season, parental intent to vaccinate, for the nation, HHS regions, states, and selected sub-state areas, with national breakdowns by age, race and ethnicity, poverty, mother's education, and urbanicity. Estimates are preliminary in-season numbers that may differ from CDC's final post-season estimates, and are subject to non-coverage of households without cell phones, selection bias, and parental recall error, which tends to overstate coverage compared with immunization registries. Seasons 2019-20 to present are included.
nis_flu.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

nis_frvm.name: National Immunization Survey-Fall Respiratory Virus Module (NIS-FRVM)
nis_frvm.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nis_frvm.location: Weekly Influenza and RSV Vaccination Coverage and Intent, Adults 18 Years and Older (FluVaxView and RSVVaxView dashboards)
nis_frvm.description: The National Immunization Survey-Fall Respiratory Virus Module (NIS-FRVM), called the NIS-Adult COVID Module (NIS-ACM) in seasons before 2025-26, is an ongoing random-digit-dialed cellular telephone survey of adults 18 years and older run by CDC's National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases. Respondents report their own receipt and timing of flu, COVID-19, and RSV vaccination; estimates are weighted to sociodemographic characteristics of the U.S. population. CDC publishes weekly cumulative flu coverage and intent for the nation, HHS regions, states, and selected sub-state areas (2021-22 season to present), and RSV coverage (ever vaccinated) and intent for adults 75 and older and adults 50-74 with high-risk conditions for the nation and HHS regions, with national breakdowns by age, sex, race and ethnicity, poverty, urbanicity, insurance, disability, and sexual orientation. Data collection for the 2025-26 season ended on 2026-02-21, earlier than in prior seasons. Estimates are preliminary and subject to the usual telephone-survey limitations; self-report tends to overstate coverage relative to immunization registries. The RSV dataset (qeq7-f3ir) covers the 2025-26 season only; CDC has published a new dataset for each RSV season.
nis_frvm.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
